title: The Five Bestial Forms in the Body of the King of Darkness
description: A correspondential portrait of self-love personified as inverted Grand Man. Lion-head (tyranny), eagle-wings (arrogance), demon-feet (dark externals), dark belly (appetite), fish-loins (submerged truth) — five bestial likenesses drawn from the Five Worlds of Darkness, complete with iron/bronze hardness, oscillation between fire and cold, and bile of wrath as his only "life." The complete inverse of the five storehouses of divine reception.
